name: tech.polydoc/polydoc-mcp
description: PolyDoc MCP server: HTML/URL to PDF, screenshots, and EU e-invoice generation for MCP clients.
title: PolyDoc

environmentVariables.name: POLYDOC_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Default sandbox mode (watermarked, does not use production quota). A tool call can override per request. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: POLYDOC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override for self-hosted or staging use. Defaults to https://api.polydoc.tech.

environmentVariables.name: POLYDOC_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory downloads are written to. Defaults to the OS temp dir + /polydoc.
